rationale: C21 supplies an unmistakable drafting template for the child's operative land-transfer clause. Both directives begin with the same valid-existing-rights qualification, identify lands acquired under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act or transferred by the same earlier directives, include waters, water rights, improvements, and structures, and transfer jurisdiction from Agriculture to another department. The child materially adapts this machinery by limiting it to specified North Dakota parcels and changing the transferee and intended use. C16 is the underlying closely parallel order, while C19 reproduces and amends its operative language, but C21 most closely matches the child's updated chain of directive references.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over the following-described lands acquired under Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, or transferred by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of June 9, 1938, as amended by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of August 31, 1940, and 10175 of October 25, 1950
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over all lands in the following-described areas acquired or in the process of acquisition under Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, or transferred by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of June 9, 1938, as amended by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of August 31, 1950 and 10175 of October 25, 1950
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive opening formula, statutory basis, and sequence of prior directive references are nearly verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to the Secretary of Agriculture for use, administration, and disposition in accordance with the provisions of the said act, together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures acquired or constructed in connection with the use and administration of said lands, is hereby transferred to the Department of the Army
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to the Secretary of Agriculture for use, administration, and disposition in accordance with the provisions of the said act, together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures acquired or constructed in connection with the use and administration of the said lands, is hereby transferred to the Department of the Interior
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same detailed bundle of transferred jurisdiction and associated property while substituting the Department of the Army for the Department of the Interior.
